comment: THE ONE TABLE of words the public page shows in place of a code (R-2026-09-23-68 C1). The page never prints a raw code: every value of every enum the page receives is either given words here under `labels`, or named under `not_yet_displayed` with the reason it is not shown. tests/compliance/public_labels.test.ts derives those enums and their values from the migrations, and tests/db/public_labels_enum.test.ts from the database catalogue, so a value added to an enum turns both red until it is decided here. An empty string is a deliberate decision that the value adds no words to the line (OFFERED, ACTIVE). A code the page receives that is not in this table renders the fallback and is logged, never shown.
